text:
sasha: Quick thread — planning an immersive refapp workshop + launch for the new OSS 'refkit-lite'. Goal: hands-on tutorial, benchmark narrative, webinar, and inbound lead routing. Want a live workshop + 3 short tutorials over 2 weeks. Thoughts?

maria: love it. can we pick week of May 10? that gives 3 weeks to promo. need CTA: signup + GitHub star + starter kit.

jon: benchmark narrative idea: simple cost/latency tradeoff chart with 3 configs (hosted small, quantized dedicated, cached pipeline). include script + dataset so people can reproduce. keep results < 1 page.

devon: demos: do we have a stable demo env? live > fallback pre-recorded. i can spin ephemeral playgrounds if someone gives me a branch/tag.

olivia: launching posts + webinar copy drafts — i'll write short, modular blocks we can reuse for tweets, blog, and slide intro. rough tweet draft below: 

```
Try RefKit Lite: a tiny reference app for running & optimizing LLM inference. Join our hands-on workshop 5/12 — build, benchmark, and ship a demo in 90 minutes. RSVP: <short.link> #RefKit #RedwoodInference :rocket:
```

Also blog outline: 1) problem + why refkit-lite, 2) what you'll build, 3) benchmark highlights, 4) how to reproduce, 5) CTA + resources.

maria: routing note — signup form should push email + org size + interest tag to Segment -> HubSpot. tag values: "refkit-lite-workshop", "oss-refapp". please also add UTMs for tweets.

jon: i'll own the benchmark automation. i'll add a minimal repo dir: `bench/` with scripts (run_bench.sh, collect_metrics.py) and a Dockerfile. link when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/refkit-lite (draft).

devon: give me the branch tag and i'll run a smoke deploy. if we need GPU-backed demos i'll allocate 1 T4 pool for the workshop window and create a snapshot for attendees who fork.

olivia: short landing copy for the signup CTA: "Build a small reference app that serves an LLM with predictable latency. Live workshop + reproducible benchmark. No infra expertise required."

sasha: tasking + micro-deadlines — please ack: 
- olivia: final copy + social pack by 5/1 
- jon: bench scripts + sample outputs by 5/3 
- devon: demo env + fork snapshot by 5/7 
- maria: HubSpot form + routing + email template by 5/6 

Can everyone reply with a quick yes/no on those dates?

maria: yes, those dates work for me. I'll draft the email nurture sequence (pre-event, day-of, follow-up).

jon: yes. aiming to include cost-per-inference table and a reproducible notebook.

devon: yes. i'll post the deploy URL here when ready.

olivia: yes. i'll add 3 tweet variations and an event hero image.

marketing-bot: Reminder set: promotional cadence starts 5/3 (3 emails, 4 social posts).

deploy-bot: demo env provisioned: https://refkit-lite-playground.staging.redwood.test (credentials in vault).

sasha: perfect. small ask — add a one-slide 'what to expect' in the workshop invite (90m agenda: 10m intro, 60m build+bench, 20m Q&A).

jon: adding bench README and a tiny plot script. will include sample command: 

```
# quick run
./bench/run_bench.sh --model redwood/small --seq 512 --iters 200
```

devon: noted. i'll prepare a fallback video of the full build in case live hits issues.

olivia: social plan: sneak preview GIF of the playground + 1 tweet about benchmark headline the day before. will share assets in `#marketing-assets`.

sasha: awesome — closing thread. will follow up with a checklist doc and invite. :thumbsup: :rocket:

maria: thanks — will drop the HubSpot form link when done. :eyes:

jon: ping me for any bench tweaks.

devon: will post deploy logs if anything flakey.

olivia: uploading hero + 3 tweet images now.

marketing-bot: Event created: "RefKit Lite — Hands-on Workshop" on 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC.
